description.en: I moved to a new place, but there is definitely something strange in that house...!

Once upon a time, Iris' greatest challenge as a socially inept mage was receiving the occasional client at her workshop. Little did she know that the nasty woman knocking on her door would change that forever.

One violent confrontation later, the two women end up switching bodies - and as it turns out, Iris' new body belongs to the kingdom's infamous shrew, Queen Rosemary!

With her original body damaged and the real Rosemary dead, Iris must continue living as the queen. But that's easier said than done when the entire royal court hates her, especially her fiery husband the king... who Rosemary was conveniently plotting to dethrone with the help of her many lovers.

Needless to say, Iris is woefully unprepared for the deadliest "ball" of her life, and not just because she's a terrible dancer.

All she can do is pray that the moon will guide her through these hopelessly dark times!

description.fr: Kwon Nameun, jeune scénariste, a récemment connu un revers de carrière ainsi qu'un dilemme romantique. Alors qu'elle retrouve son béguin de lycée qui l'a larguée sans pitié il ya sept ans, comment est-elle censée affronter ses sentiments pour cet adonis devenu acteur, pour qui elle s'est un jour engagé sur la voie de l' écriture de scripts ? Elle doit se persuader qu'elle a déjà lâché prise. Heureusement, elle rencontre un chanteur sympathique, doux et beau, qui lui fait des blagues à l'heure du déjeuner, avec qui elle a des conversations nocturnes et peut-être… une raison parfaite… de lâcher prise totalement. description.en:
“Your Highness, there’s something I’d really like for my birthday.”

“What is it?”

“Will you promise to listen?”

Then the man blatantly laughed.

But who would point out his arrogance – a young Northern Duke who’s not even afraid of the Emperor? He could even get a throne if he wished for it.

But it was just a sweet lover’s birthday wish.

“Alright. I swear.”

So, Juliet spoke lightly,

“Please break up with me. I don’t love you anymore.”

A fiance just for show. A succession of meaningless nights.

Now is the time to end seven years of unrequited love.

Ara and Graham are childhood friends who used to have a sibling-like relationship. When they are finally placed in the same class (since the age of 8) as they enter their 2nd year of high school, their situation begins to change towards an unexpected direction. Will they be able to cross the line of dating, or not?

Chyoo Lee Ning, jerk Eun Jeh, pretty boy Yun Jun woo, if it’s liking or just bullying the one year younger guy who confuses people… Hyun bin. Heh young, who believes that the strongest person can achieve love… This is a love story about different teens.

description.id:
Tahun 2020. Ini adalah era WeTube. Ada WeTubers dengan kemampuan istimewa, melewati batas pembuatan konten masyarakat biasa, mendirikan 'Sekolah WeTube' dimana para murid berkumpul untuk meraih kekayaan dan ketenaran melalui channel yang viral. Puncak dari para WeTuber ini adalah channel [Dot]. Tiga tahun lalu,  channel itu terlibat kontroversi yang mengejutkan dan kemudian bersembunyi. Namun, faktanya adalah mereka dimanipulasi oleh kekuatan luar!
"Aku akan membersihkan namaku dengan menggunakan video WeTube sebagai buktinya," Kata Yihwasoo, WeTuber yang mewarisi channel [Dot] dan memasuki Sekolah WeTube untuk balas dendam.

Meanwhile, Rok's jaded, twenty-something cousin Belle suffers a messy breakup with her boyfriend. Finally, Rok, who dreads the thought of growing up and its attendant responsibilities, hates men and is sure to complicate matters. Get ready for one wild ride with 10, 20, and 30.

Але в нього є одна проблема – його існування під загрозою через повну відсутність грошей! Є й рішення – щоб їх отримати, хлопчині доведеться відправитися в пекло до диявола. Ні, ні! Або ж краще померти від голоду?.. Коротше, друзі завжди прийдуть на допомогу – отримуй, Педро, те, що заслужив. Найгарячіша історія найдивніших відносин, які могли коли-небудь існувати... Сучасна бізнес-леді і довірливий студент, настирливі друзі і незвичайний секретар нікого не залишать байдужими.

But by some stroke of luck, a mysterious man, Jung Yool, witnesses the entire incident and helps Deokhee cover it up. However, something imperceptibly sinister seems to be lying beneath Jung Yool’s helpful facade…

When her father's sudden death put her on the throne, she was happy to become the Queen Consort instead, letting her husband Halon rule as the King of Zerlasha. Little did she know that Halon would scheme behind her back, allying with the powerful Kingdom of Cavenia, an erstwhile enemy. With her country Zerlasha falling prey to corruption and crime, the time arrives for Agatha to step up as a true queen and leader. Will Queen Agatha take a stand against King Halon to save her country and protect her people?

description.en:
“Damn it!”

She was not promoted because of her ex-boyfriend and superior. Noah put up with it, but there was only one thing she could do, reaching the end of her patience.

“Let’s get rid of the insignia and fight!”

“It’s not fun. Let’s make the winner’s wish come true”

And so the two of them…

“Are we going to share the sword as a wedding gift when we make our wedding vows?”

“If it’s okay to cut the lieutenant general with that sword, I will gladly do it.”

“You want a red dress? You are fierce, my bride. By the way, my eyes are also red, did you wear it for me?”

“If only it could be stained with the blood of the lieutenant general.”

“Then, starting today, I will collect them one drop at a time.”

“Don’t suffer like that, I’d rather kill you at once.”

“Noah, you are so hot and fierce…! You should say that in bed!”

“Just die the first night.”

“Then bury me in a couple’s tomb. I’ll wait till you die. How about the sea?”

“I prefer the land.”

Noah shuddered as she pondered over and over what Leto had said. Why did she have a relationship with a guy like that?

“I’m not really crazy…”

No matter how much she thought about it, she couldn’t come up with a proper answer other than his face and body.

And Ami’s gaze at such a friend was only cold.

“You’re weird too.”
description.fr: On lui a refusé une promotion à cause de son ex-petit-ami et patron. Noah avait l'habitude d'endurer, mais elle avait atteint la limite de sa patience et elle ne pouvait faire qu'une seule chose: Combattre! C'est comme ça qu'elle jetta son insigne par terre et demanda un duel à l'homme, dont la réponse fut positive, il proposa en plus que le perdant devra exaucer le souhait de l'autre. Entre frustration, coup bas et amertume, ces deux là sauront-ils mettrent leur rancune de côté?
description.ko:
“빌어먹을!”

전남친 겸 상관 때문에 진급에서 떨어졌다.
노아는 참을 만큼 참았으나,
인내의 한계에 다다른 그녀가 할 수 있는 건 딱 하나였다.

“계급장 떼고 한 판 붙자!”
“그냥은 재미없으니, 이긴 사람 소원 들어주기 할까?”

그리고 두 사람은...

= = =
“결혼 서약을 할 때 예물로 검을 나눠 가질까?”
“그 검으로 중장님을 베어도 된다면, 기꺼이 하겠습니다.”
“붉은 드레스가 입고 싶다고? 격하네, 내 신부...”
“중장님 드디어 정신을 놓으셨습니까?”
“그러고 보니 내 눈동자도 붉은데, 혹시 날 위해서?”
“중장님의 피로 물들일 수 있다면야.”
“그럼 오늘부터 한 방울씩 모아볼게.”
“그럴 고생 마시고, 제가 단번에 죽여드리겠습니다.”
“노아 너 정말 뜨겁고 격해...! 그런 건 침대에서 말해야지!”
“그냥 첫날밤에 사망해 주십시오.”
“그러면 부부 합장묘로 묻어 주라. 네가 죽을 때까지 기다릴게. 바다 수장 어때?”
“저는 매장을 선호합니다만.”

노아는 레토가 했던 말을 몇 번이고 곱씹으며 치를 떨었다. 내가 왜 저런 놈이랑 그렇고 그런 사이가 되었던 거지?

“정말 보통 미친 게 아니야...”

아무리 생각해도 얼굴과 몸 말고는 제대로 된 답이 나오지 않았다.

“......”

그리고 그런 친구를 바라보는 아미의 시선은 싸늘하기만 했다.

“너도 이상해.”

description.en:
High school alumni met after 5 years, Kim Hyun-oh and Kim Chan-i. However, the circumstances of the two are completely reversed! Hyeon-oh, who went from being a popular fighter to a lethargic rake. Chan-yi, who was bullied at school, has been transformed into a pretty boy. A sweet reunion in which the two heal each other's wounds. 

In high school, Kim Chan-yi was unusually white and fat. Everyone called him Piglet. Now, his body was reduced to almost half. The only thing he hadn't changed since then was his white skin like glutinous rice cakes. He Was he that tall and broad-shouldered? His eyes were large and round, and his nose was pointed. It was a kind and friendly impression. Just like the male lead in a romance manga, a glowing effect seems to float nearby. If you compare it to an animal, what should I say? dog? squirrel? Rabbit? if it's a rabbit it looked like a rabbit A thin white rabbit. Chan-yi Kim's change was amazing. I couldn't even recognize it at first glance. Kim Chan-yi cleared her throat a bit. Then I realized that he had been looking at his face for too long. ”You've changed a lot.” Kim Chan-yi nodded. In an instant, his ears and cheeks turned bright red. It was like that when he was in high school too. It reminds me of the way he used to blush.
description.es:
Los ex alumnos de la escuela secundaria se conocieron después de 5 años, Kim Hyun-oh y Kim Chan-i. Sin embargo, ¡las circunstancias de los dos son completamente invertidas! Hyeon-oh, que pasó de ser un peleador popular a un libertino letárgico. Chan-yi, que sufría acoso en la escuela, se ha transformado en un niño bonito. Un dulce reencuentro en el que los dos curan las heridas del otro.

***

En la escuela secundaria, Kim Chan-yi era inusualmente blanco y gordo. Todos lo llamaban Piglet.

Ahora, su cuerpo se redujo a casi la mitad. Lo único que no había cambiado desde entonces era su piel blanca como tortas de arroz glutinoso. ¿Era tan alto y tenía los hombros anchos? Los ojos eran grandes y redondos, y la nariz puntiaguda. Fue una impresión amable y amistosa. Al igual que el protagonista masculino en un manga romántico, un efecto brillante parece flotar cerca. Si lo comparas con un animal, ¿qué debo decir? ¿perro? ¿ardilla? ¿Conejo? si es un conejo parecía un conejo Un conejo blanco delgado.

El cambio de Chan-yi Kim fue sorprendente. Ni siquiera pude reconocerlo a primera vista. Kim Chan-yi se aclaró la garganta un poco. Entonces me di cuenta de que había estado mirando su rostro durante demasiado tiempo.

"Has cambiado mucho."

Kim Chan-yi asintió. En un instante, sus orejas y mejillas se pusieron de color rojo brillante. Era así cuando estaba en la escuela secundaria también. Me recuerda la forma en que solía sonrojarse.

공감 100% 에 도전한다~ 절대 센스 Wony와 함께하는 골방 환상곡! 네이버 전격 오픈!

늑대 워니와 그의 친구 곰이 보여주는 리얼 공감 스토리~

description.en:
Wol Yeon of the great Yeon clan in the Kingdom of Asatae is a spirited girl who dreams of becoming a general one day. 

Her dreams are crushed when the royal government mercilessly eradicates her clan, murdering everyone, including Wol’s parents. Wol is left with no one she can trust but her tutor Jae-i, who proceeds to raise and train her as a master assassin so that she may take revenge against the king. 

Eight years later, Wol successfully infiltrates the palace to kill the king, only to find that all is not as it seems…

---

Note: This work was adapted from [the 2024 drama of the same name](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Love_Song_for_Illusion).
description.ko:
왕을 시해하려다 기억을 잃고 쓰러진 자객이 다음 날 후궁으로 책봉된다면?

반역자로 몰려 몰살당한 연씨 가문의 유일한 생존자 연월은 왕에게 복수하기 위해 자신의 신분을 숨긴 채 자객이 된다.

무희로 잠입해 은밀히 왕의 목을 노리지만, 왕이 쳐 놓은 덫에 빠져 오히려 독한 향에 정신을 잃고 쓰러진다.

다음 날, 연월은 과거의 기억을 잃은 채 눈을 뜨게 되고, 뜻밖에 왕명을 받아 후궁 은효비에 책봉된다.

현왕은 자신을 죽이러 온 자객인 연월을 후궁으로 들인 악희의 소행에 분노하며 후궁전으로 달려가 연월을 죽이려 하지만,도리어 악희에게 몸의 통제권을 빼앗기고 마는데...

description.en:
After a freak accident shatters his dreams, Suyeong sets off on a cruise with his younger sister, Heesu.

But an unknown virus breaks out on board, and a head-taking monster begins attacking passengers.

In the chaos, Suyeong is separated from his sister, with nothing but the open sea to run to.

Can he find Heesu and escape the ship alive?

altTitles.ja: 離婚後、仮想通貨で大儲け!

description.en:
The year of marriage was terrible. But after the divorce, unbelievably good things started to happen

While sorting through the belongings of my father,  who was obsessed with gambling, I found a coin.

 Did he buy the coin with the 10 million won I lent him?
